import numpy as np
class CMAEvolutionStrategy:
 def __init__(self,x,sigma,opts):
  self.mean=np.array(x);self.sigma=sigma;self.n=len(x);self.lam=opts['popsize'];self.mu=self.lam//2
  w=np.log(self.mu+.5)-np.log(np.arange(1,self.mu+1));self.w=w/w.sum();self.mueff=1/np.sum(self.w**2)
  n=self.n;mu=self.mueff
  self.cc=(4+mu/n)/(n+4+2*mu/n);self.cs=(mu+2)/(n+mu+5)
  self.c1=2/((n+1.3)**2+mu);self.cmu=min(1-self.c1,2*(mu-2+1/mu)/((n+2)**2+mu))
  self.damps=1+2*max(0,np.sqrt((mu-1)/(n+1))-1)+self.cs
  self.C=np.eye(n);self.pc=np.zeros(n);self.ps=np.zeros(n);self.g=0;self.chi=np.sqrt(n)*(1-1/(4*n)+1/(21*n*n));self.rng=np.random.default_rng(opts.get('seed',42))

  self.z=self.rng.normal(size=(self.lam,self.n));self.y=(self.z*self.D)@self.B.T
  return self.mean+self.sigma*self.y
 def tell(self,xs,ys):

  self.mean+=self.sigma*yw
  self.ps=(1-self.cs)*self.ps+np.sqrt(self.cs*(2-self.cs)*self.mueff)*(self.inv@yw)
  self.g+=1
  hs=np.linalg.norm(self.ps)/np.sqrt(1-(1-self.cs)**(2*self.g))/self.chi < 1.4+2/(self.n+1)
  self.pc=(1-self.cc)*self.pc+hs*np.sqrt(self.cc*(2-self.cc)*self.mueff)*yw

 lo=ss.low.action_low;hi=ss.low.action_high

base[5,3:5]=[-.2,-.1];base[6,0]=old[4];base[7,0]=old[5]
base=base.ravel()

def features():
 R=d.xmat[12].reshape(3,3);B=d.xmat[23].reshape(3,3)
 pitch=np.arctan2(R[0,2],R[2,2]);roll=np.arctan2(-R[1,2],R[2,2])
 bp=np.arctan2(B[0,2],B[2,2]);br=np.arctan2(-B[1,2],B[2,2])
 xp=d.subtree_com[1,0];yp=d.subtree_com[1,1];vx,vy=d.sensordata[2:4]
 fp=np.array([1,xp,vx,pitch,d.qvel[4],bp,d.qvel[29],d.qpos[26],d.qvel[25]])

 yaw=np.arctan2(R[1,0],R[0,0]);by=np.arctan2(B[1,0],B[0,0])
 fy=np.array([1,yp,vy,yaw,d.qvel[5],by,d.qvel[30],d.qpos[27],d.qvel[26]])
 return fp,fr,fy

def act(p):
 p=p.reshape(8,9);fp,fr,fy=features()
 h,a,k=p[:3]@fp;r,kd=p[3:5]@fr;y=p[5]@fy;sh=p[6]@fp;sr=p[7]@fr
 q=np.zeros(19);q[[2,7]]=h;q[3]=k+kd;q[8]=k-kd;q[[4,9]]=a;q[[1,6]]=r;q[[0,5]]=y

  goodness=np.exp(-2*v*v-8*(1-upr)-5*max(0,2.02-h)**2)*(.95+.05*np.exp(-force))

   pair=d.contact[j].geom
   if (0 in pair and 45 not in pair) or (45 in pair and 0 not in pair and 43 not in pair):bad=True;break
  if bad:break
